response: Starting today, Saved Views is available to help you and your team work faster inside your projects. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a list, you can now save the exact configuration you rely on and return to it in one click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so there's nothing extra to add to your subscription to start using it. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views by project, priority, client, or workflow stage without running out of space. Views aren't limited to personal use, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filters and stays aligned on what matters most. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or keeping an eye on a client's work, Saved Views makes it easy to jump straight to what you need. We think this update will make daily project management noticeably smoother for teams of every size. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
